capabilities: Track issues and pull requests from specific GitHub repositories
Sync GitHub data automatically on startup or via a manual command
Filter tracked items by assignee and reviewer
Create standardized Markdown notes for each issue or pull request
Configure per-repository folders, update and delete behavior
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian community plugins list; manual installation from GitHub releases is described. Includes content escaping modes to guard against malicious synced content.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to follow GitHub issues and pull requests or turn them into notes you can edit and organize.

relations.evidence: integrates with GitHub to track issues and pull requests directly in your vault

summary: GitHub integration that syncs issues and pull requests from chosen repositories into Markdown notes in your vault.
